scripts.contracts: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -- contracts --output-dir api-docs && cp -f api-docs/openrpc.json ../generated/nano-node-v28.2.openrpc.json
scripts.validate: npm run validate:openrpc && npm run validate:asyncapi
scripts.models: asyncapi generate models typescript api-docs/asyncapi.json --no-interactive --tsModelType interface --tsExportType named --output .model-smoke
scripts.generate: npm run contracts && npm run validate && npm run site
